resources.string: ⚡ Camera & ISP Subsystem Tweaks: 4K 60FPS, 150Mbps Bitrate, 50MP RAW, Leica Profiles & Dual Video
Unlocks true 3840×2160 @ 60 FPS recording in MIUI / HyperOS Camera. Bypasses MediaTek HAL streaming resolution limits and adds the 60 FPS toggle switch.
Boosts default 4K video recording from 42 Mbps up to 150 Mbps HEVC (c2.mtk.hevc.encoder) for crystal-clear master quality with zero compression banding.
Enables true 50-megapixel uncompressed RAW (.dng) sensor capture in Pro Mode directly from the Sony IMX766 quad-bayer matrix.
Injects Leica Authentic and Leica Vibrant color science tuning profiles, Leica optics simulation, and the official Leica branded watermark.
Unlocks Director Mode: simultaneous front (OV16A1Q) + rear (Sony IMX766) multi-camera video recording.
Expands Pro mode exposure time up to 60 seconds long exposure for astrophotography and up to 1/16000s ultra-fast electronic shutter.
Completely disables MIUI / HyperOS thermal warnings, video recording overheat alerts, and forced camera shutdown. Camera will never close due to high temperature, even under extreme load.
